text: dsh-pwa 是面向手机浏览器的 DSH PWA 界面，挂载在 DSH web 的 /m 路径，并通过同源 DSH API 操作会话。它提供会话列表与消息搜索、流式聊天、审批和 agent 问答交互，也可查看会话交付文件并使用系统分享。适合希望通过 iOS 或 Android 浏览器远程继续使用 DSH 的人；需要一台运行中的 DSH web 服务，不需要为本插件配置 API key。

dsh-pwa adds a phone-friendly PWA at /m on the DSH web server. It uses the same-origin API for session browsing and search, streaming chat, approvals, agent questions, and sharing session files. Use it from an iOS or Android browser with a running DSH web server; no plugin API key is needed.
想从手机浏览器查看并继续操作 DSH 会话。
我想在手机上搜索以前会话里的消息内容。
能不能在手机上边聊边看到 agent 的回复？
希望在手机上处理 agent 发来的审批和问题。
I want to manage my DSH sessions from a phone browser.
Can I search the full text of my past session messages on mobile?
dsh-pwa 的功能「移动会话列表」：在手机界面查看会话，并按标题或路径筛选；选择会话后可继续查看和操作。
dsh-pwa 的功能「消息全文搜索」：输入查询词后调用 session/search 搜索会话消息，并显示摘要以便跳转到对应会话。
dsh-pwa 的功能「流式聊天与审批」：在会话中接收实时消息，并以卡片展示待处理审批和 agent 问题供用户回应。
dsh-pwa 的功能「交付文件分享」：查看会话交付文件，并通过设备支持的系统分享功能发送文件。
dsh-pwa 的功能「会话整理」：对会话执行改名、分叉或归档，分叉后进入新会话。
让 DSH 在手机浏览器里也能查看会话并发送消息。
I need to approve an agent action or answer its question while away from my computer.

**DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.** A phone-first PWA for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`): it mounts at `/m` on your `dsh web` server — streaming chat, approvals and questions, plus a reminder center, deliverable files with share/AirDrop, full-text session search, and message feedback. No app install: open it in mobile Safari/Chrome → *Add to Home Screen* → full-screen app. iOS and Android.

dsh-pwa README · Why a PWA instead of a native app?：| | **dsh-pwa** | saya-ch/dsh-mobile | Official web UI over Tailscale |
|---|---|---|---|
| Form | PWA, zero install on the phone | Native Android app + plugin | Desktop-first web UI |
| iOS | ✅ (Safari → Add to Home Screen) | ❌ (Android only) | ✅ (browser) |
| Android | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Remote access | Inherits `dsh web` (LAN / Tailscale / any reverse proxy) | Built-in: LAN, Tailscale Funnel, cpolar, cloudflared, FRP | Manual `tailscale serve` |
| Push notifications | ❌ (iOS PWA limits) | ✅ (Android system notifications) | ❌ |
| Security model | Same origin + dsh `trusted-host` fence | Cert pinning + device pairing | `trusted-host` fence |
| Maintenance surface | Static files only — speaks the same `/api` as the desktop GUI | Native app + plugin to maintain | None (official UI) |

dsh-pwa README · Features：- 📋 **Session list** with last-message previews, unread dots, day grouping, workspace grouping, pull-to-refresh, a "needs attention" filter (pending approvals / questions), and rename / fork / archive
- 🗂 **Session info menu**: the ⋯ sheet shows the session title, Session ID and working path (tap either to copy), with settings grouped into chat / content / manage sections
- 🔎 **Global search**: local title/path filtering plus full-text message search (`session/search`) with highlighted snippets that jump straight to the session
- 💬 **Streaming chat**: optimistic send, per-day dividers, timestamps, code-copy buttons, full-screen image viewer; dual send modes — queue while running, long-press to steer — and queued messages can be edited / steered / removed
- ✅ Approvals & ❓ agent questions as tappable cards (dangerous commands get a red double-confirm)
- 📦 **Deliverables & workspace files**: files the agent `present`s become timeline cards (inline image preview, direct text read) with share/AirDrop and open-on-Mac actions; the ⋯ menu browses the whole session workspace with per-turn change hints
- ⏰ **Reminder center**: a third home tab lists every reminder
dsh-pwa README · Features：The full UX audit trail lives in [docs/AUDIT.md](docs/AUDIT.md) — 148 items, all fixed, each with the root cause.

dsh-pwa README · Quick start：Prerequisite: desktop `dsh` CLI installed.

**1.** Create (or reuse) a web profile, `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`:

```json
{
  "name": "dsh-profile-web",
  "private": true,
  "dependencies": {

**2.** Install and start (add your access domain to the trust fence when the phone connects from outside):

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && npm install
dsh --profile web --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3080 --trusted-host <your-access-domain>
```

dsh-pwa README · Quick start：**3.** On your phone, open `http://<host>:3080/m/` → *Share → Add to Home Screen* for the full-screen PWA.
   - Same LAN/Wi-Fi: `<host>` is the server's LAN IP.
   - Away from home: use [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) — add your Tailscale hostname to `--trusted-host` in step 2 (Tailscale must be running on both the server and the phone, logged into the same account), then open `http://<tailscale-hostname>:3080/m/`.

dsh-pwa README · Quick start：Upgrade later with `npm update dsh-pwa` and a `dsh web` restart. The plugin only mounts static files; the page speaks DSH's own `/api`, so it moves with your DSH version (developer-preview caveat in the FAQ below).

dsh-pwa README · Quick start：> **Enabling global search**: the shipped web bundle keeps the full-text index off; set `session-query-sqlite` → `openAt: first-search` in your profile patch. Note: the 0.2.1-rc.x indexer requires a write-free persistence window while building, which conflicts with resident bots (ds-bot heartbeats every 20–40 s) — pick one until upstream relaxes the quiescence check.

dsh-pwa README · How it works：- The server does exactly one thing: mount `web/` as static files at `/m` (`lib/routes.js`, self-healing if the webServer instance is recreated).
- The page talks directly to DSH's own `/api` — the identical protocol the desktop GUI uses (`POST /api/<ns>/<method>`, `POST /api/respond`, `ws://…/api/events.mux` downstream frames). Zero business-logic duplication.
- Tailscale works out of the box because it reuses the existing `trusted-host` fence.
dsh-pwa README · How it works：Iterating on the UI needs no restart: files are re-read per request, just refresh the page.

dsh-pwa README · Contributing：Vanilla JS, no build step, no framework. `web/` is the app, `lib/` is the mount, `client/` injects the desktop settings entry. Details in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). PRs welcome — especially the roadmap items above.

dsh-pwa README · FAQ：**Does it work on iPhone?** Yes — that's the point. Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen.

**Do I install anything on the phone?** No. It's a web page.

**Is it safe to expose?** Same threat model as `dsh web` itself: anyone who can reach the URL (your tailnet / LAN) can drive your agent. Keep it inside a trusted network; don't put it on the public internet.

**Does it work offline?** No — it needs a live connection to your `dsh` server.

dsh-pwa README · FAQ：**What happens when auth expires?** The page shows a "re-login" dialog: paste the startup link `dsh web` printed on your Mac (or the bare token) and the app mints a fresh login in place — no reinstall required.

dsh-pwa README · FAQ：**Will a DSH update break it?** The page speaks the same `/api` as the desktop GUI and ships no protocol logic of its own, so it moves with your DSH version. That said, DSH is still in developer preview and its API may change in breaking ways — if that happens, the plugin will need a matching update.
